params.who_you_are: <role + identity the resuming agent should assume, e.g. 'autonomous implementer continuing PR work in repo X' — one sentence, no conversational-memory dependence>

verified_facts: <fact verified at seed-time, e.g. 'branch feat/x is 2 commits ahead of origin/main at sha abc1234'>
env: <relevant env/runtime fact, e.g. 'node 22 via mise', 'jq present'>

guardrails: <binding constraint, e.g. 'never commit secrets', 'worktree-only edits', 'do NOT merge'>
dag: <what comes AFTER this mission completes, e.g. 'then: PDCA on PR review comments → merge gate'>

refs.git: <repo URL or owner/name + branch + PR number(s)>

principles: Liberdade com Responsabilidade — proactive autonomy, but every delegated subordinate is your responsibility; the tree returns to the root; audit the output; zero drift.
Previsibilidade Holistica (Efeito Borboleta) — wait for dependencies/swarms to finish before advancing; cause->effect, action->consequence.
Independencia Agnostica (Self-Healing) — use the most competent resource in the generic pool; if it does not exist, build it; be the solution; capability-detected, cross-vendor (AAIF).
session_learnings: <up to 5 distilled lessons from this session>
dna.learnings_ref: <path to the DNA learnings log, or 'none'>

params.resume_instructions: Run /maos:preflight first; then follow bootstrap_order; then start at the first non-blocked next_action. INTERNALIZE params.dna: adopt the 3 principles, and TRANSCRIBE them verbatim into the briefing of every sub-agent you spawn (DNA Geracional is inherited, not optional).
